question: Where can I get the planned new power lines and substations in the United States, with location, voltage, planned date and status?

answer.summary: PJM's live XML, CAISO's annual plan and status workbooks, and MISO's MTEP package list regional upgrades and give project descriptions, status and estimated in-service dates. The sources checked give locations by name, state or occasional point. No downloadable route geometry or national dataset was verified. Filter out equipment-only, canceled and completed work when looking for new lines and substations.
main_caveats: No national list was found: PJM, CAISO and MISO were read, ERCOT was blocked (403), ISO-NE only via a PDF update, and NYISO, SPP, BPA and individual utilities were not opened.
Files give names and state, not routes: only 16 of 15,816 PJM rows embed a coordinate; CAISO and MISO give substation names and text; CAISO route maps are images in the plan.
The 19 Nov 2026 PJM snapshot had 15,816 upgrades and 5,637 pending or active records. Filter out breakers, relays, reconductoring and other work outside the scope of new lines and substations.
Listing or approval is not construction: PJM Board approval, MISO 'Appendix A Approved' and CAISO plan approval precede permits; expected in-service dates are revised often.
Versions change under one URL: CAISO's main plan URL now serves the 2026-08-27 update, MISO's MTEP26 package is a draft, and PJM's XML is overwritten in place.
answer.confidence_reason: Three operators downloaded and parsed; ERCOT blocked, ISO-NE partial, NYISO, SPP, BPA unopened. Claims are limited to the operators read; no route data was found.

attributes.note: Substation or line names and state only (PJM Location, MISO From/To Sub, CAISO descriptions); no routes; 16 of 15,816 PJM rows embed a point.
attributes.gap_note: No route geometry in the files tested; ERCOT, NYISO, SPP, the ISO-NE list file and project permit filings were not checked for routes.

attributes.note: PJM Voltage in kV (pairs like 138/69; 642 blank), MISO Max kV and Min kV, CAISO kV in project names and descriptions.
PJM ProjectedInServiceDate, MISO Expected ISD, CAISO expected in-service (Appendix H, TDF history); approval and required dates are separate fields.
PJM Status (PL, EP, UC, IS, Cancelled), MISO Plan Status M1-M4, CAISO TDF Project Status (Initiating, Design, Construction, In-Service, Cancelled).
PJM XML modified 2026-11-19; CAISO plan updated 2026-08-27; MISO MTEP25 (Dec 2025) and MTEP26 draft (2026-11-06); CAISO TDF workbook retrieved only to Jul 2025.
CAISO TDF keeps in-service date revisions Jan 2022-Jul 2025; PJM lists projects since 2005 but only its current state; MISO has one package per year.
attributes.gap_note: No versioned archive of the PJM table found (only a 2023 XLS snapshot); CAISO TDF workbooks after Jul 2025 were not retrieved.

attributes.note: CAISO states twice-yearly forums and an annual plan; MISO publishes annual MTEP packages; PJM refreshed its XML on the day tested but states no schedule.
attributes.gap_note: PJM and MISO pages read state no update schedule; re-fetching file headers over several days would show PJM's real cadence.

sources.name: PJM RTEP Project Status & Cost Allocation upgrades table (XML and XLS export)
sources.format: XML, one Upgrade element per upgrade (the page table also exports to XLS)
sources.summary: Live XML with description, kV, state, location text, status and dates. The 19 Nov 2026 snapshot had 15,816 upgrades, including 5,637 pending or active records.
sources.coverage_note: PJM footprint only; names and state, no routes (16 rows embed a point); many rows are equipment upgrades, not new lines or substations.
caveats: Active status means queue-linked and not yet under agreement
A 2023 XLS on the same page is stale

problems: The page's 'Latest TCIC version' XLS is a 2023 snapshot (last modified 2023-07-12).

example.example_request: curl -sL -o projectCostUpgrades.xml 'https://www.pjm.com/pjmfiles/media/planning/projectConstruction-data/projectCostUpgrades.xml' ; parse each <Upgrade>, keep Status in (PL, EP, UC, UC-ISP, Active, On Hold) and Equipment in ('Transmission Line', 'Substation')
example.example_result: UpgradeId b3780.2: 'Peach Bottom to Graceton (PECO) - New 500 kV transmission line', Voltage 500, State PA, Status UC, ProjectedInServiceDate 10/23/2028, PJMBoardApprovalDate 7/12/2023, TransmissionOwner PECO, LastUpdated 11/4/2026.

sources.name: CAISO 2025-2026 Transmission Plan (Board approved 2026-05-19, updated 2026-08-27) and Appendix H project descriptions
sources.format: PDF (plan 181 pages; Appendix H 25 pages, one block per project)
sources.summary: CAISO's annual plan lists 38 approved projects; Appendix H describes 33 with kV, miles, type, expected in-service date and cost, and plan tables give IDs and previously approved project status.
sources.coverage_note: CAISO area only; text and PDF; no coordinates; dates are those at approval.
caveats: Main plan URL now holds the 2026-08-27 update
Many projects are upgrades, not new lines

problems: The original 2026-05-19 plan text is no longer at the main plan URL, which serves the 2026-08-27 update.

example.example_request: curl -sL -o apph.pdf 'https://www.caiso.com/documents/board-approved-2025-2026-transmission-plan-appendix-h-projects.pdf' ; pdftotext -layout apph.pdf apph.txt ; split on lines starting with 'Name'
example.example_result: Name 'Trout Canyon - Lugo 500 kV Line': 'Build a new 500 kV transmission line from Trout Canyon 500 kV substation to Lugo 500 kV substation, approximately 180 miles, with 70% series compensation'; Type Policy; Expected In Service Date 2035; Project Cost $1,270 - $1,800 million (plan ID 2526-P-04, SCE).

sources.name: CAISO Transmission Development Forum workbooks: Approved Projects - Transmission Planning Process
sources.format: XLSX, one sheet per transmission owner (PGaE, SCE, SDGaE, VEA_GLW, DCRT, LSPower, CitizensEnergy, Lotus, HWT)
sources.summary: Twice-yearly CAISO workbooks track every approved transmission project with status, permit filing and construction milestones, and expected in-service dates by forum since 2022.
sources.coverage_note: Retrieved edition is July 2025 (230 projects); no kV or location columns; January and July 2026 editions not found.
caveats: Newer 2026 workbooks exist but were not located

problems: The stakeholder page's static HTML lists documents only through the July 2025 forum; guessed names for the January and July 2026 workbooks returned HTTP 500.

example.example_result: SCE sheet: 'Alberhill 500 kV Method of Service', approved plan 2009, Expected In-Service at the Jul 2025 forum 47453 (2029-12-01 as Excel serial), Project Status 'Engineering', Expected CPUC Permit Application 40057 (2009-09-01).

sources.name: MISO Transmission Expansion Plan MTEP25 package: Appendix A new local reliability projects and facilities list
sources.format: ZIP with XLSX workbooks and PDF chapters
sources.summary: MISO's MTEP25 package gives 432 Appendix A projects and 678 facility rows with from/to substations, kV, new miles, plan status M1-M4 and expected in-service date; a draft MTEP26 has 532 projects.
sources.coverage_note: MISO footprint; substation names and state only; interactive status reports need sign-in.
caveats: Appendix A is recommended for approval, mostly M1 Proposed
'Other' project type mixes load-growth and local needs

problems: MTEP Project Tracking pages (Appendix A Status Report, In-Service Projects, Projects Under Evaluation) redirect to a sign-in page.

example.example_request: curl -sL -o MTEP25.zip 'https://cdn.misoenergy.org/MTEP25731615.zip' ; unzip, open 'MTEP25 Appendix A - New Local Reliability Projects.xlsx', sheets 'MTEP25 Appendix A' (header row 2) and 'MTEP25 Facilities' (header row 1)
example.example_result: Facilities row PrjID 50628: Transformer Fayette/Wolf Creek - Edwards, Max kV 345, Min kV 138, Miles New 33, IN, Plan Status 'M2 - Appendix A Approved', Expected ISD 47299 (2029-06-30); owner Wabash Valley Power Association.

sources.name: Other ISO and RTO planning lists (ISO-NE RSP Project List; ERCOT regional planning)
sources.publisher: ISO New England; Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT)
sources.format: PDF update presentation (ISO-NE); ERCOT not reached
sources.summary: ISO-NE posts semiannual RSP Project List updates as presentations with project IDs, descriptions, cost and owner; ERCOT's planning page was blocked.
sources.coverage_note: ISO-NE only through one PDF of changes; the full list and ERCOT data were not retrieved.
caveats: Presentation lists changes, not the whole list

problems: ERCOT planning page https://www.ercot.com/gridinfo/planning returned HTTP 403 to a default client, so no ERCOT planning list was read.

example.example_result: Project 1672: 'Forest Ave Substation modification required to build a new 115 kV line from Sudbury Station 342 substation to Hudson substation', cost 8.5 ($M), Hudson Light and Power, placed in service since the June 2025 update.

members_summary.scope_note: Universe: US grid planners outside CAISO, PJM and MISO (other ISO/RTOs and non-RTO utilities); no census page opened, so the total is not established. Listed and tested: ISO-NE (presentation only) and ERCOT (blocked). Not opened: NYISO, SPP, BPA, TVA and utility plans.

if_unstructured.summary: CAISO's approved projects live in PDF appendices and plan tables; extract them to get kV, miles and expected years. PJM and MISO publish tables; routes are only in plan figures and permit filings.

local_terms.meaning: PJM's regional plan; its upgrades have b-numbers such as b3780.2
MISO's annual plan; Appendix A lists new projects recommended for approval
CAISO's annual cycle producing the Board-approved transmission plan
CAISO's twice-yearly status review of approved projects
Utility that builds and owns a CAISO-approved project, e.g. PG&E or SCE
Expected date a project enters service
PJM project types: regional reliability, owner-driven, and generator-interconnection upgrades
A previously approved project whose scope or cost was changed in a later plan

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
